translations.english: And the name of the second river is Gihon; that is the one that encircles the whole land of Cush.
And the name of the third river is Tigris; that is the one that flows eastward of Assyria, and the fourth river is the Euphrates.
And Awtsmoos Elokim took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to work it and to guard it.
And Awtsmoos Elokim commanded man, saying, "From every tree of the garden you may freely eat.
But from the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat from it, for on the day that you eat from it, you shall surely die."
And Awtsmoos Elokim said, "It is not good that man should be alone; I shall make him a helper corresponding to him."
